definitions.gloss: cool and refreshing; fresh and invigorating
definitions.explanation: Describes a pleasantly cool and refreshing sensation, often associated with clean air, clear water, or a cooling breeze.

examples.japanese: {清涼|せいりょう}な⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}いた→吹く：02445_fuku⟧。
{清涼|せいりょう}{飲料水|いんりょうすい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a refreshing soft drink.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{清涼|せいりょう}で、⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{吹|ふ}き{飛|と}んだ→吹き飛ぶ：11842_fukitobu⟧。
examples.english: The mountain air was cool and refreshing, and the fatigue of city life vanished all at once.

notes:
Conveys a clean, pure coolness that is invigorating rather than merely cold. Most commonly encountered in the compound ⟦{清涼飲料水|せいりょういんりょうすい}→清涼飲料水：17030_seiryouinryousui⟧ (soft drinks/refreshing beverages), which is an official product category in Japan. As a standalone adjective, it has a somewhat literary or formal tone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{清涼飲料水|せいりょういんりょうすい}→清涼飲料水：17030_seiryouinryousui⟧: soft drink, refreshing beverage
- {清涼|せいりょう}{感|かん}: refreshing sensation
- {清涼|せいりょう}な⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧: crisp, fresh air
- {清涼|せいりょう}な⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧: refreshing breeze

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{爽|さわ}やか→爽やか：05701_sawayaka⟧: refreshing, invigorating — more common in everyday speech and broader in usage
- ⟦{涼|すず}しい→涼しい：00674_suzushii⟧: cool — describes temperature directly, less emphasis on purity
- {冷涼|れいりょう}: cool (climate) — used mainly for weather and climate descriptions
